Server-Sent Events: a `progress` event on every stage change, then one `done` event.

Progress is read from MongoDB, so any API process can serve the stream.

post.description: Parse a resume: text, sections, contact details and the ATS format report.
Parse a job description given as pasted `text` or an uploaded `file` (exactly one).
Extract a structured profile: skills (normalized), roles, experience, education.
Extract hiring requirements: must-have vs nice-to-have skills, years, seniority.
Score synchronously, without saving or suggestions. Use `POST /api/scans` in the app.

ResumeAnalysis.description: Everything Phase 2 learns from a resume file.

experience_years.title: Experience Years
experience_years.description: Computed from role dates (internships excluded); falls back to the stated years when roles have no dates

title.description: Job title exactly as written, e.g. 'Software Engineer II'

end.title: End
end.description: 'YYYY-MM', 'YYYY', or 'present' for a current role; null if unknown

is_internship.title: Is Internship
is_internship.description: True for internships, trainee or apprentice positions

ScanResult.title: ScanResult

ScanStage.title: ScanStage
ScanStage.description: Pipeline stage, streamed to the frontend as progress.

SkillRequirement.title: SkillRequirement
SkillRequirement.description: One JD skill requirement, satisfied by any of its (canonical) options.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short action, at most 10 words, e.g. 'Show your AWS work'

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: One to three sentences: what to change and why it helps

example.title: Example

overview.title: Overview
